name: Synthesis of Co(ttpp) (discontinued due to leakage)
plain_text_description:
NMR
M1: TTPP, Et3N(·HX), TrBr?, THF
M2: TTPP, Et3N(·HX), TrBr?, THF
M3: TrBr?, THF
M4: Co(III)(ttpp)(thf)2 [ring current + chemical exchange], TrBr?, THF
M5: broader
M6: similar to M4
Et3N evaporated off because of the leak
Co(ttpp) was oxidized by HBr and DCl in CDCl3

Heat a 50 mL two-neck RBF in an oven (120°C) for >1.5 h.
[08.01., RT 21.5°C, RH 24 %]
Assemble and fix a reflux condenser (NS29/42), a T-shaped connector, and a bubbler (filled with paraffin oil) at a Schlenk line. [A smaller reflux condenser should have been used without enlarging adapter]
Remove the RBF and quickly assemble it with a stir bar, rubber septum, enlarging adapter, and reflux condenser while it is still hot.
Evacuate (0.23 mbar) and heat the bottom part of the reflux condenser and flask with a heat gun (250°C). [The vacuum level was low because the gas ballast valve was open]
Backfill with N₂. [The N2 line was found to be leaking after this experiment. Air contamination might be possible]
Add TAPP and TrBr (plastic spatula) quickly
Cycle with N₂ slowly x3
Add Et3N
Add the THF syringe. [09:15] (greenish-black mixture)
Start stirring (350 rpm)
Cover the flask with Al foil.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl₃ 500 µL, sonicate → ¹H NMR M1 [09:25]
[10:37] → 0.1 mL → syringe filter + CDCl₃ 500 µL, sonicate → 1H NMR M2
Stop stirring. Close the N₂ connection. Add CoCl₂ quickly.  Purge with N₂ for 10 s. Close. Resume stirring. [12:45]
Bubble with N₂, 30 min. [–13:15]
[13:32] Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm) for ca. 15 min (Mixture volume almost dried up, greenish-brown)
Add 10 mL THF (bubbled with N2 for 20 min) and seal the joint with Teflon tape.
Heat for 2 h (Mixture volume did not decrease, reddish-brown)
Cool down to RT.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl₃ 500 µL → syringe filter → sonicate → ¹H NMR M3 [15:55]
Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm)
→ 0.2 mL → syringe filter + CDCl₃ 500 µL → sonicate → ¹H NMR M4 [16:10]
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl₃ 500 µL → syringe filter → sonicate → ¹H NMR M5 [17:40]
[09.01.]
[8:00] Cool down to RT.
→ 0.1 mL + CDCl₃ 500 µL → syringe filter → sonicate → 1H NMR M6 [08:15]
Heat to reflux (85 °C, 1.25 atm) for 1 h
Discontinued
